description.en: The ID of the instance to update.

descriptions.zh: ><notice>阿里云提供的OpenAPI属于管控类API，用于管理和查询阿里云服务的相关资源。仅推荐在管控链路集成，消息收发的核心数据链路中严禁依赖OpenAPI实现，否则可能会导致链路产生风险。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

Alibaba Cloud's OpenAPI is a control plane API for managing and querying cloud resources. Use it on the control path only. Do not use this API on the core data path for message transport, as this can compromise service reliability.

></notice>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq update-instance --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --instance-name test_instance --remark This_is_the_remark_for_test. --network-info '{"internetInfo":{"ipWhitelist":["192.168.x.x/24"]}}' --product-info sendReceiveRatio=0.5 autoScaling=true traceOn=true messageRetentionTime=72 --acl-info '{"aclTypes":["apache_acl"],"defaultVpcAuthFree":false}' --region cn-hangzhou
